*Cross-domain threat investigation for Microsoft 365*

Read-only companion to Microsoft''s **Hybrid Attack – Cloud & Identity**, not a replacement incident queue or detection engine.

**No results does not mean safe or undetected.** Check source readiness, field mappings, query warnings, retention and RBAC first. Optional sources may be unavailable without breaking other panels. This package has not been executed against your tenant.

Choose a workspace and a period entirely within the **last 30 days**. Older/future periods are unsupported and evidence panels return no rows. A fixed 90-day query envelope prevents the service time picker from clipping baseline/snapshot queries; each query still filters its own narrower event windows. Use **Entity** for an exact UPN (email/data), or a supported native alert entity (incident lookup). Use **AppId** for the OAuth hunt. Results from different panels are independent evidence, not an automatically proven attack chain. Optional email and data panels are off by default.

let EndTime = {TimeRange:end};
let Expected = datatable(Source:string, Scenario:string, Notes:string) [
    ''AuditLogs'', ''OAuth consent'', ''Consent target and operation must be available'',
    ''AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs'', ''OAuth app-ID mapping'', ''Needed when consent audit lacks explicit application ID'',
    ''CloudAppEvents'', ''OAuth activity'', ''Requires application IDs compatible with Entra AppId'',
    ''SecurityAlert'', ''Related alerts'', ''Entity fields must support exact matching'',
    ''SecurityIncident'', ''Related incidents'', ''Alert-ID linkage required; historical snapshots may be outside query window'',
    ''EmailEvents'', ''Optional email'', ''Recipient and message ID required'',
    ''UrlClickEvents'', ''Optional email clicks'', ''Clicks without message IDs cannot be linked'',
    ''OfficeActivity'', ''Optional data-impact audit'', ''Operation and outcome require analyst interpretation'',
    ''MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection'', ''Optional Purview labels'', ''Does not include all Purview/DLP/Insider Risk signals''
];
let Observed = union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(Source:string, Scenario:string, Notes:string, ProbeResolved:long, CurrentEvents:long, UsableKeyEvents:long, HistoricalEvents:long, FirstObserved:datetime, LastObserved:datetime, MaximumLagMinutes:long) []),
(AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated >= StartTime - 14d and TimeGenerated <= EndTime
    | summarize CurrentEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime),
        UsableKeyEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime and (isnotempty(tostring(TargetResources)))),
        HistoricalEvents=countif(TimeGenerated < StartTime),
        FirstObserved=min(TimeGenerated), LastObserved=max(TimeGenerated),
        MaximumLagMinutes=max(datetime_diff(''minute'', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated))
    | extend Source=''AuditLogs'', Scenario=''OAuth consent'', ProbeResolved=1, Notes=''Consent target and operation must be available''),
(AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated >= StartTime - 14d and TimeGenerated <= EndTime
    | summarize CurrentEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime),
        UsableKeyEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime and (isnotempty(ServicePrincipalId) and isnotempty(AppId))),
        HistoricalEvents=countif(TimeGenerated < StartTime),
        FirstObserved=min(TimeGenerated), LastObserved=max(TimeGenerated),
        MaximumLagMinutes=max(datetime_diff(''minute'', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated))
    | extend Source=''AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs'', Scenario=''OAuth app-ID mapping'', ProbeResolved=1, Notes=''Needed when consent audit lacks explicit application ID''),
(CloudAppEvents
    | where TimeGenerated >= StartTime - 14d and TimeGenerated <= EndTime
    | summarize CurrentEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime),
        UsableKeyEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime and (isnotempty(tostring(OAuthAppId)))),
        HistoricalEvents=countif(TimeGenerated < StartTime),
        FirstObserved=min(TimeGenerated), LastObserved=max(TimeGenerated),
        MaximumLagMinutes=max(datetime_diff(''minute'', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated))
    | extend Source=''CloudAppEvents'', Scenario=''OAuth activity'', ProbeResolved=1, Notes=''Requires application IDs compatible with Entra AppId''),
(SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated >= StartTime - 14d and TimeGenerated <= EndTime
    | summarize CurrentEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime),
        UsableKeyEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime and (isnotempty(SystemAlertId) and isnotempty(tostring(Entities)))),
        HistoricalEvents=countif(TimeGenerated < StartTime),
        FirstObserved=min(TimeGenerated), LastObserved=max(TimeGenerated),
        MaximumLagMinutes=max(datetime_diff(''minute'', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated))
    | extend Source=''SecurityAlert'', Scenario=''Related alerts'', ProbeResolved=1, Notes=''Entity fields must support exact matching''),
(SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated >= StartTime - 14d and TimeGenerated <= EndTime
    | summarize CurrentEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime),
        UsableKeyEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime and (isnotempty(tostring(AlertIds)))),
        HistoricalEvents=countif(TimeGenerated < StartTime),
        FirstObserved=min(TimeGenerated), LastObserved=max(TimeGenerated),
        MaximumLagMinutes=max(datetime_diff(''minute'', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated))
    | extend Source=''SecurityIncident'', Scenario=''Related incidents'', ProbeResolved=1, Notes=''Alert-ID linkage required; historical snapshots may be outside query window''),
(EmailEvents
    | where TimeGenerated >= StartTime - 14d and TimeGenerated <= EndTime
    | summarize CurrentEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime),
        UsableKeyEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime and (isnotempty(NetworkMessageId) and isnotempty(RecipientEmailAddress))),
        HistoricalEvents=countif(TimeGenerated < StartTime),
        FirstObserved=min(TimeGenerated), LastObserved=max(TimeGenerated),
        MaximumLagMinutes=max(datetime_diff(''minute'', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated))
    | extend Source=''EmailEvents'', Scenario=''Optional email'', ProbeResolved=1, Notes=''Recipient and message ID required''),
(UrlClickEvents
    | where TimeGenerated >= StartTime - 14d and TimeGenerated <= EndTime
    | summarize CurrentEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime),
        UsableKeyEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime and (isnotempty(NetworkMessageId) and isnotempty(AccountUpn))),
        HistoricalEvents=countif(TimeGenerated < StartTime),
        FirstObserved=min(TimeGenerated), LastObserved=max(TimeGenerated),
        MaximumLagMinutes=max(datetime_diff(''minute'', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated))
    | extend Source=''UrlClickEvents'', Scenario=''Optional email clicks'', ProbeResolved=1, Notes=''Clicks without message IDs cannot be linked''),
(OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated >= StartTime - 14d and TimeGenerated <= EndTime
    | summarize CurrentEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime),
        UsableKeyEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime and (isnotempty(UserId) and isnotempty(OfficeObjectId))),
        HistoricalEvents=countif(TimeGenerated < StartTime),
        FirstObserved=min(TimeGenerated), LastObserved=max(TimeGenerated),
        MaximumLagMinutes=max(datetime_diff(''minute'', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated))
    | extend Source=''OfficeActivity'', Scenario=''Optional data-impact audit'', ProbeResolved=1, Notes=''Operation and outcome require analyst interpretation''),
(MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection
    | where TimeGenerated >= StartTime - 14d and TimeGenerated <= EndTime
    | summarize CurrentEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime),
        UsableKeyEvents=countif(TimeGenerated >= StartTime and (isnotempty(UserId) and isnotempty(ObjectId))),
        HistoricalEvents=countif(TimeGenerated < StartTime),
        FirstObserved=min(TimeGenerated), LastObserved=max(TimeGenerated),
        MaximumLagMinutes=max(datetime_diff(''minute'', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated))
    | extend Source=''MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection'', Scenario=''Optional Purview labels'', ProbeResolved=1, Notes=''Does not include all Purview/DLP/Insider Risk signals'');
Expected
| join kind=leftouter (Observed | project-away Scenario, Notes) on Source
| extend State=case(isnull(ProbeResolved), ''Unavailable or inaccessible: inspect query warnings'',
    CurrentEvents == 0, ''No events in selected period: not proof of connector failure'',
    UsableKeyEvents == 0, ''Events present but required linkage keys absent'',
    ''Observed usable keys: validate operation-level coverage''),
    Baseline=iff(coalesce(HistoricalEvents, 0) == 0, ''No pre-window history observed'', ''History observed; completeness not established'')
| project Source, Scenario, State, CurrentEvents, UsableKeyEvents, HistoricalEvents, Baseline,
    FirstObserved, LastObserved, MaximumLagMinutes, Notes
| where StartTime >= ago(30d) and EndTime <= now() + 5m and StartTime < EndTime
| order by Source asc

A strict pre-window 14-day baseline avoids the upstream overlapping-baseline defect. Correlation requires an explicit Entra client AppId or an unambiguous service-principal-to-AppId mapping; IP-only correlation is not used. Unresolvable consent records are intentionally excluded. Validate that CloudAppEvents.OAuthAppId uses the same identifier. Event volume is not a maliciousness score."}},{"type":3,"name":"oauth","content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","title":"Ordered OAuth hunt candidates (not enabled detections)","query":"let StartTime = {TimeRange:start};
let EndTime = {TimeRange:end};
let SelectedApp = tolower(trim(@"\s+", base64_decode_tostring(''{AppId:base64}'')));
let MinimumEvents = tolong(base64_decode_tostring(''{MinimumEvents:base64}''));
let PrincipalMap =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (datatable(ServicePrincipalId:string, AppId:string) []),
        (AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated >= StartTime - 14d and TimeGenerated <= EndTime
        | project ServicePrincipalId=tolower(tostring(ServicePrincipalId)), AppId=tolower(tostring(AppId)))
    | where isnotempty(ServicePrincipalId) and isnotempty(AppId)
    | summarize Apps=make_set(AppId, 2) by ServicePrincipalId
    | where array_length(Apps) == 1
    | project PrincipalKey=ServicePrincipalId, MappedAppId=tostring(Apps[0]);
let ConsentChanges =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (datatable(ChangeTime:datetime, Operation:string, TargetId:string, ExplicitAppId:string, Initiator:string, ConsentCorrelationId:string) []),
        (AuditLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
        | where Result =~ ''success''
        | where OperationName in~ (''Consent to application'', ''Add delegated permission grant'', ''Add app role assignment to service principal'')
        | extend Initiator=coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId))
        | mv-expand Target=TargetResources
        | where tostring(Target.type) in~ (''ServicePrincipal'', ''Application'')
        | extend Props=array_concat(todynamic(Target.modifiedProperties), dynamic([{"displayName":"_fallback","newValue":""}]))
        | mv-expand Prop=Props
        | extend PropertyName=tolower(tostring(Prop.displayName)), ParsedValue=parse_json(tostring(Prop.newValue))
        | extend ExplicitAppId=iff(PropertyName in (''appid'', ''applicationid'', ''app.appid''),
            tolower(trim(@''[\s"\[\]]+'', tostring(ParsedValue))), '''')
        | project ChangeTime=TimeGenerated, Operation=OperationName,
            TargetId=iff(tostring(Target.type) =~ ''ServicePrincipal'', tolower(tostring(Target.id)), ''''),
            ExplicitAppId, Initiator, ConsentCorrelationId=tostring(CorrelationId))
    | lookup kind=leftouter PrincipalMap on $left.TargetId == $right.PrincipalKey
    | extend AppKey=coalesce(ExplicitAppId, MappedAppId)
    | where AppKey matches regex ''^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$''
    | where isempty(SelectedApp) or AppKey == SelectedApp
    | summarize by ChangeTime, Operation, AppKey, Initiator, ConsentCorrelationId;
let AppActivity =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (datatable(ActivityTime:datetime, AppKey:string, Account:string, SourceIp:string, Action:string, EventId:string) []),
        (CloudAppEvents
        | where TimeGenerated >= StartTime - 14d and TimeGenerated <= EndTime
        | project ActivityTime=TimeGenerated, AppKey=tolower(tostring(OAuthAppId)),
            Account=tostring(AccountId), SourceIp=tostring(IPAddress), Action=tostring(ActionType), EventId=tostring(ReportId))
    | where isnotempty(AppKey)
    | where isempty(SelectedApp) or AppKey == SelectedApp;
let HistoricalApps = AppActivity
    | where ActivityTime >= StartTime - 14d and ActivityTime < StartTime
    | summarize by AppKey;
let NovelActivity = AppActivity
    | where ActivityTime between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | join kind=leftanti HistoricalApps on AppKey;
ConsentChanges
| join kind=inner NovelActivity on AppKey
| where ActivityTime >= ChangeTime and ActivityTime <= ChangeTime + 24h
| summarize FirstActivity=min(ActivityTime), LastActivity=max(ActivityTime), EventCount=count(),
    Accounts=make_set(Account, 20), SourceIps=make_set(SourceIp, 20), Actions=make_set(Action, 20), EventIds=make_set(EventId, 20)
    by AppKey, ChangeTime, Operation, Initiator, ConsentCorrelationId
| where EventCount >= MinimumEvents
| extend Interpretation=''Hunt candidate: same app, ordered activity; not proof of compromise or actor attribution''
| where StartTime >= ago(30d) and EndTime <= now() + 5m and StartTime < EndTime
| order by FirstActivity desc

Requires a nonempty Entity and exact supported entity fields. This is not automatic candidate deduplication. SecurityIncident uses the latest snapshot within the queried 30-day pre-period window; older or unsynchronized incidents may not appear. No match means no match found in this query scope—not that Microsoft missed an attack."}},{"type":3,"name":"incidents","content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","title":"Related native alerts and incident links","query":"let StartTime = {TimeRange:start};
let EndTime = {TimeRange:end};
let SelectedEntity = tolower(trim(@"\s+", base64_decode_tostring(''{Entity:base64}'')));
let Alerts =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (datatable(AlertTime:datetime, AlertId:string, AlertName:string, Severity:string, EntitiesJson:string, Product:string) []),
        (SecurityAlert
        | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
        | project AlertTime=TimeGenerated, AlertId=tostring(SystemAlertId), AlertName=tostring(AlertName),
            Severity=tostring(AlertSeverity), EntitiesJson=tostring(Entities), Product=tostring(ProductName))
    | where isnotempty(SelectedEntity)
    | mv-expand MatchedEntity=parse_json(EntitiesJson)
    | extend EntityType=tolower(tostring(MatchedEntity.Type)),
        Upn=tolower(iff(isnotempty(tostring(MatchedEntity.UPNSuffix)),
            strcat(tostring(MatchedEntity.Name), ''@'', tostring(MatchedEntity.UPNSuffix)), '''')),
        HostFqdn=tolower(iff(isnotempty(tostring(MatchedEntity.DnsDomain)),
            strcat(tostring(MatchedEntity.HostName), ''.'', tostring(MatchedEntity.DnsDomain)), ''''))
    | where (EntityType == ''account'' and (SelectedEntity == Upn or SelectedEntity == tolower(tostring(MatchedEntity.AadUserId)) or SelectedEntity == tolower(tostring(MatchedEntity.Sid))))
        or (EntityType == ''ip'' and SelectedEntity == tolower(tostring(MatchedEntity.Address)))
        or (EntityType == ''host'' and (SelectedEntity == tolower(tostring(MatchedEntity.HostName)) or SelectedEntity == HostFqdn))
        or (EntityType == ''cloud-application'' and SelectedEntity == tolower(tostring(MatchedEntity.AppId)))
        or (EntityType == ''azure-resource'' and SelectedEntity == tolower(tostring(MatchedEntity.ResourceId)))
    | summarize arg_max(AlertTime, *) by AlertId;
let Incidents =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (datatable(IncidentModified:datetime, IncidentNumber:long, IncidentTitle:string, Status:string, IncidentUrl:string, IncidentAlerts:dynamic) []),
        (SecurityIncident
        | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime - 30d .. EndTime)
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentName
        | project IncidentModified=TimeGenerated, IncidentNumber=tolong(IncidentNumber),
            IncidentTitle=Title, Status, IncidentUrl, IncidentAlerts=AlertIds)
    | mv-expand IncidentAlertId=IncidentAlerts
    | extend IncidentAlertId=tostring(IncidentAlertId);
Alerts
| join kind=leftouter Incidents on $left.AlertId == $right.IncidentAlertId
| project AlertTime, AlertName, Severity, Product, AlertId, IncidentNumber, IncidentTitle, Status, IncidentUrl,
    MatchBasis=''Exact supported entity field; association is not causation''
| where StartTime >= ago(30d) and EndTime <= now() + 5m and StartTime < EndTime
| order by AlertTime desc

let EndTime = {TimeRange:end};
let SelectedEntity = tolower(trim(@"\s+", base64_decode_tostring(''{Entity:base64}'')));
let SelectedMessage = trim(@"\s+", base64_decode_tostring(''{MessageId:base64}''));
let Messages =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (datatable(MessageTime:datetime, MessageId:string, Recipient:string, Sender:string, Subject:string, DeliveryAction:string, ThreatTypes:string) []),
        (EmailEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
        | project MessageTime=TimeGenerated, MessageId=tostring(NetworkMessageId), Recipient=tolower(tostring(RecipientEmailAddress)),
            Sender=tostring(SenderFromAddress), Subject=tostring(Subject), DeliveryAction=tostring(DeliveryAction), ThreatTypes=tostring(ThreatTypes))
    | where (isnotempty(SelectedMessage) and MessageId == SelectedMessage)
        or (isempty(SelectedMessage) and isnotempty(SelectedEntity) and Recipient == SelectedEntity);
let Clicks =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (datatable(ClickTime:datetime, MessageId:string, ClickAccount:string, Url:string, ClickAction:string, ClickThrough:bool) []),
        (UrlClickEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
        | project ClickTime=TimeGenerated, MessageId=tostring(NetworkMessageId), ClickAccount=tolower(tostring(AccountUpn)),
            Url=tostring(Url), ClickAction=tostring(ActionType), ClickThrough=tobool(IsClickedThrough))
    | where isnotempty(MessageId);
Messages
| join kind=leftouter Clicks on MessageId, $left.Recipient == $right.ClickAccount
| where isnull(ClickTime) or ClickTime >= MessageTime
| project MessageTime, MessageId, Recipient, Sender, Subject, DeliveryAction, ThreatTypes, ClickTime, Url, ClickAction, ClickThrough,
    Interpretation=''Message/recipient association only; click telemetry does not prove successful authentication or execution''
| where StartTime >= ago(30d) and EndTime <= now() + 5m and StartTime < EndTime
| order by MessageTime desc

let SelectedEntity = tolower(trim(@"\s+", base64_decode_tostring(''{Entity:base64}'')));
union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(EventTime:datetime, Source:string, Account:string, Operation:string, ObjectId:string, LabelId:string, Outcome:string, EvidenceId:string) []),
    (OfficeActivity

    | project EventTime=TimeGenerated, Source=''OfficeActivity'', Account=tolower(tostring(UserId)),
        Operation=tostring(Operation), ObjectId=tostring(OfficeObjectId),
        LabelId=tostring(column_ifexists(''SensitivityLabelId'', '''')),

    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | project EventTime=TimeGenerated, Source=''MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection'',
        Account=tolower(tostring(column_ifexists(''UserId'', ''''))),
        Operation=tostring(column_ifexists(''Operation'', '''')),

| where isnotempty(SelectedEntity) and Account == SelectedEntity
